title: LA passage: claritas
html_source:
This passage is marked in the Open Editions semantic edition as a la passage.

claritas

Language: la

anchor.prefix: the necessary phases of artistic apprehension. Find these and you find the qualities of universal beauty. Aquinas says: Ad pulcritudinem tria requiruntur integritas, consonantia,
anchor.suffix:
. I translate it so: Three things are needed for beauty, wholeness, harmony and radiance. Do these correspond to the phases of apprehension? Are you following?

 —Of course, I am,
